Step Numbers Rules

Each side writes numbers into the middle column of its sheet, then cards are turned up. A card is written in only next to a neighbouring number: one less on the left, one more on the right. Whoever first fills every field wins.

The rules

Your sheet
Each side has a sheet with rows of three fields. Before the game, each side writes the same number of numbers into the middle column: 4 numbers from 0 to 5 (Easy), 7 numbers from 0 to 9 (Medium) or 10 numbers from 0 to 15 (Hard). A number may be used more than once. Black writes first. Tap a number, "Random numbers" fills the rest, and "Undo" takes the last number back.
The cards
The stack holds four cards of every number. On your turn, draw the top card. A card that is one less than a middle number fits the left field of that row; a card that is one more fits the right field. If several fields fit, tap the one you want. If no field fits, the card is out and the other side is next. An empty stack is shuffled again.
The edges
A field that can never be filled (left of 0, or right of the highest number) counts as filled from the start. A middle number at the edge therefore needs only one card.
Winning
Whoever first has every field of their sheet filled wins. Black turns up the first card.
The computer
Writing a card in leaves little choice, so the strength lies in the middle column. Easy picks numbers at random, Medium takes the better of two random numbers, Hard picks numbers that need few cards and spread the need evenly. The Hint button suggests what Hard would do.
